title: 💰 World Bank $8–10 Billion Annual Financing Framework (FY26–31) & PM-SETU $830M Loan
summary: World Bank Group launched new Country Partnership Framework (CPF) for India committing $8-10 billion annual lending over FY26-FY31 for private-sector jobs, including $830 million loan for PM-SETU ITI skilling.

blocks.content: **Overview**: World Bank Group launched new Country Partnership Framework (CPF) for India committing $8-10 billion annual lending over FY26-FY31 for private-sector jobs, including $830 million loan for PM-SETU ITI skilling.

items: **World Bank Announces $8–10 Billion Annual Financing CPF for India (FY26–FY31)** (Page 13): World Bank Group launched new Country Partnership Framework (CPF) for India committing $8-10 billion annual lending over FY26-FY31 for private-sector jobs, including $830 million loan for PM-SETU ITI skilling.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Multilateral Sovereign Development Financing. 5-year World Bank CPF (FY26-FY31) delivering $8-10B annually, including $830M facility for 1,000 ITI modernizations under PM-SETU.
